payload.body: nahel progress refused --since 7d because it validated the flag against journalEventSchema.shape.ts — the journal's STORAGE format, which is necessarily absolute — while standup and decisions resolved the same flag through resolveSince (src/views/standup.ts), which accepts a relative span or an ISO timestamp. The spec never reached the resolver, so the usage line and the error text described the narrow parser truthfully and nothing surfaced the divergence. The general lesson: validating a user-facing flag against a storage schema silently narrows it, because a stored value is always the already-resolved form. A flag shared by several verbs needs one resolver called by all of them, with the clock read in the command (ctx.env.now()) so the view still sees only the resolved absolute cutoff.
